title: What the located EMC trabectedin denominator actually is
purpose: RT-TRABECTEDIN and a submission-targeted manuscript both carried figures the cited registry withdrew on 2026-08-07, and one asserted a 'reported EMC responder' with no identifier. This artifact records, at primary source, every EMC patient this repository has located who received trabectedin, what response each series reports, and what may NOT be combined with what.
the_question: How many EMC patients has this repository located who received trabectedin, and how many objective responses are reported among them?

answer.why_not_pooled: Two different designs (a randomised phase 2 sub-analysis with central radiology review; a retrospective real-world post-hoc with investigator-assessed RECIST 1.1) on two different populations (Japan, JapicCTI-121850; Italy, ISG TrObs 2010-2015). POLICY-evidence §2.6(a) forbids a pooled estimate across populations §2.1 would not pool, and §2.6(c) permits only counts and order statistics. The two rows are therefore stated SEPARATELY. '5' is a count of located patients, not a pooled denominator, and it carries no interval.
answer.median_pfs_in_emc: UNKNOWN — no EMC-specific median PFS exists in the located record. See `withdrawn_figures` below. The absence is the finding; it is not replaced by another median.

series.citation: Palmerini E, Sanfilippo R, Grignani G, et al. Transcription regulators and ultra-rare and other rare translocation-related sarcomas treated with trabectedin: a proof of principle from a post-hoc analysis. Front Oncol 2022;12:1042479.
series.design: post-hoc analysis of a case series drawn from the Italian Sarcoma Group TrObs study (NCT02793050), a non-interventional retrospective study of 512 anthracycline-pretreated advanced STS patients enrolled at 20 Italian sites, January 2010 to December 2015; investigator-assessed RECIST 1.1
series.arm_composition: 36 patients with ultra-rare or other rare translocation-related sarcoma; 35 evaluable for response; EMC n=3
series.emc_best_response: Table 2, EMC row: ORR '-', stable disease 2 (66.7%), disease control 2 (66.7%), progressive disease 1 (33.3%), total 3
series.emc_median_pfs_months: not reported — Table 3 reports PFS by histology only for the three histologies that produced an objective response (ASPS, SFT, DSRCT); EMC is not among them
series.arm_wide_responders_were: one SFT partial response, one ASPS partial response, one DSRCT complete response — no EMC responder
series.read_level: FULL TEXT, retrieved 2026-09-01 via the PubMed MCP get_full_text_article on PMC9780071; Tables 1, 2 and 3 read directly

explicitly_not_added.citation: Chiusole B, Le Cesne A, Rastrelli M, et al. Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma: Clinical and Molecular Characteristics and Outcomes of Patients Treated at Two Institutions. Front Oncol 2020;10:828.
explicitly_not_added.what_it_reports: second-line trabectedin, disease control in 2 of 3 EMC patients
why_not_added: It reports a DISEASE-CONTROL RATE, not response counts. The source does not separate objective responses from clinical benefit, so no {events, denom} pair for an objective response can be extracted (POLICY-evidence §2.1(2); this is already the registry's own recorded reason for holding the row at pool:false).

⚠ POPULATION-OVERLAP RISK, UNRESOLVED. Chiusole's cohort is Istituto Oncologico Veneto (Padova, Italy) plus Institut Gustave Roussy, diagnoses 1980-2018. Palmerini's TrObs cohort is 20 Italian sites, enrolment 2010-2015 — a window that sits inside Chiusole's. Both report exactly 3 EMC patients on trabectedin and both report exactly 2 of 3 with disease control. Whether these are the same three patients is NOT established here, and POLICY-evidence §2.3 puts the burden the other way: where populations may overlap, the smaller/overlapping cohort stays out. Adding it would risk counting the same patients twice.
explicitly_not_added.what_would_resolve_it: The TrObs primary publication (Palmerini, Cancers 2021) lists its 20 participating sites; if Istituto Oncologico Veneto is among them the overlap is real and the two rows must never be summed. Not fetched here — the ISG site list is not in the post-hoc full text.

withdrawn_figures.figure: median PFS ~12.5 months for trabectedin in EMC
withdrawn_figures.status: WITHDRAWN as an EMC figure on 2026-08-07 and NOT replaced
withdrawn_figures.what_it_actually_is: the Kaplan-Meier median PFS of the Morioka trabectedin arm across all five mixed subjects (95% CI 7.4 to not reached). Table 2's five individual PFS values are 13.0, 7.4, 22.2, 7.5 and 12.5 months, so it coincides with subject 5's own value — also a mesenchymal chondrosarcoma patient. The two EMC subjects' values are 13.0 and 7.4 months.
withdrawn_figures.note: A withdrawn median is not replaced by a different median. Palmerini reports no EMC-specific median PFS either (Table 3 is restricted to the three histologies that produced an objective response), so the located record contains NO EMC median PFS for trabectedin.

withdrawn_figures.what_it_actually_is: n=2 EMC patients, PRIMARY provenance. The '5' came from reading the Morioka abstract's phrase 'five subjects with EMCS and MCS' as five EMC patients; the full text's Methods state the split — 'we adopted TWO EMCS subjects and three MCS subjects who had been allocated to the trabectedin group'.
withdrawn_figures.coincidence_warning: ⛔ A DIFFERENT AND CORRECT '5' NOW EXISTS: the located EMC denominator across BOTH series is 5 patients (2 + 3). It is a different quantity from the withdrawn single-series n=5 and must never be presented as a vindication of it.

search_performed.bound_on_this_negative: This is a bounded search over PubMed-indexed titles and abstracts on one date, with two of the seven read at abstract level only. It establishes that no reported objective response to trabectedin in an EMC patient is indexed in PubMed under these queries. It is NOT a claim that no such report exists anywhere — see the candidate below, which is not PubMed-indexed.

what_this_artifact_does_not_claim: No efficacy claim for trabectedin in EMC. Disease control in a small number of patients is not efficacy.
No claim that trabectedin is inactive in EMC. 0 of 5 is a count from a very small located record with wide uncertainty; POLICY-evidence §2.5's limitations apply in full.
No safety, eligibility, therapeutic-window or clinical-readiness claim.
No claim that the Chiusole and Palmerini patients ARE the same patients — only that overlap has not been excluded and therefore they may not be summed.
